# monotaur_probe (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur probe by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_probe" "http" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the probe to look up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the probe is active.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the probe was created.
- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this probe belongs to.
- `schedule` (String) The schedule expression for the probe.
- `sensor_ids` (List of String) IDs of sensors associated with this probe.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the probe was last updated.
